parsed.why: Most Protective tier: GENDA, hate-crime coverage, gender-neutral bathrooms, shield law, repealed loitering statute. National passport/entry and custody regime still applies, capping the gain.

No state bathroom or adult-care ban, but no statewide gender-identity nondiscrimination or hate-crime coverage; rights depend on four municipal ordinances. Slightly above the hostile national baseline.

2025 law bars gender-congruent facilities in schools and state-owned buildings; no gender-identity protections; hate-crime gap; court barred birth-marker changes. Clear state-level exposure above the national regime.
Most Protective tier with broad 2006 protections, gender-identity hate-crime coverage, gender-neutral restrooms, care shield. National border, document and custody rules remain the binding exposure.

Bathroom ban, 2023 executive order covering state facilities, birth-marker prohibition, public-funding care ban with criminal penalty, no gender-identity protections or hate-crime coverage. Most restrictive dossier.
